items.summary: LLM agents compact long histories to fit their context windows, but the compacted context must still carry the operating rules that govern later actions. Prior work shows that violations rise after compaction, but measures compliance outside a complete agent harness and does not identify where each violation comes fro…

items.summary: Progress in robot learning, particularly physical multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), is currently challenged by a limited availability of accessible, standardized benchmarks. items.summary: Large language model applications are increasingly being organized as tool-using and multi-agent workflows rather than as isolated chat interfaces. This perspective paper examines the architectural problem that follows from that shift: agents may reason, invoke tools, and delegate work, but dependable deployment still…

items.title: TRIO: Task Refinement with Individual Optimization for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.summary: This paper studies retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which leverages external knowledge to improve the performance of language models. items.title: ATrust: Adaptive Trust Boundary Expansion for Securing LLM Agents
items.summary: As large language model (LLM) agents take on more complex tasks with greater autonomy, security has become a major obstacle to their broader deployment. Unlike in attacks that require complex exploitation of operating system vulnerabilities, attackers can easily hijack agents through indirect prompt injection (IPI), l…

items.title: GeoGuesser Bench: Benchmarking Vision-Language Agents on Interactive Geolocation
items.summary: Vision-language model (VLM) agents that act in the open world need two abilities: world knowledge to interpret what they see, and exploration to find what they cannot yet see. items.summary: Indirect prompt injection creates a distinctive risk for blue-team Large Language Model (LLM) agents in Security Operations Centers (SOCs). items.title: Flat Features, Detailed Images? Simple Detail Control for Diffusion Transformers
items.summary: Prompt engineering is commonly used to encourage text-to-image models to generate more detailed images. However, it does not provide reliable, continuous, or disentangled control. items.title: Beyond Prompt Injection: The Tool Update Gap in LLM Agent Security
items.summary: Large language model based agents increasingly rely on external tools to invoke services and interact with web resources. items.summary: Mobile UI understanding and generation require both fine-grained component perception and reliable structured synthesis. items.summary: AI data analysis today is three fragmented worlds: LLMs understand semantics but cannot compute; BI aggregates precisely but is stateless; ML processes large-scale data on a stateful kernel but lacks semantics. items.summary: LLM agents that operate over long inputs must perform context management: deciding what to retain in a fixed-size context window. Fixed project and local MCP servers disconnecting after the first turn in some Claude desktop sessions
Fixed stdio MCP servers receiving an empty AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK when their env config sets it to empty; the variable is now unset, so the server can use the machine's own AWS credentials
Self-hosted runner: Fixed an MCP server that was switched off coming back on after the session moved to a new machine, when the session service had refused to save the switch
[Cloud sessions] Added a link card to cloud sessions, so you can open or decline a link an MCP server asks you to visit instead of the request going unseen
Fixed sonnet, opus and haiku on Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock showing an error mid-session instead of switching to an older model when the newest is not yet available to the account or region
Self-hosted runner: Fixed an MCP server's on/off switch sometimes being lost when a session moved to a new machine
[Cloud sessions] Added a form card to cloud sessions, so you can fill in or decline a form an MCP server asks for instead of the request being canceled without you seeing it
Fixed MCP servers that also work without sign-in showing "needs authentication" after their stored sign-in stopped working; they are now used signed out
[VSCode] Fixed "Clear authentication" for MCP servers reporting success when the saved sign-in could not be removed
Changed OpenTelemetry mcp_server.name to report the real name of fixed-URL remote MCP servers declared by plugins from the official Anthropic marketplace, instead of custom
Fixed interrupting Claude not taking effect until a timeout while an MCP server had not answered a resource read or a skill was still downloading
Fixed long hidden thinking being cut off as idle on Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS, where the endpoint sends thinking progress updates

Changed ultrathink in the interactive terminal to run its turn at xhigh effort on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 and Fable 5.1 through Anthropic's API; typed while Claude is working, it raises the rest of that turn
Windows: Fixed PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks letting a tool call through when Git Bash is missing and the hook's command is only quoted strings, such as a quoted path
Fixed a disabled MCP server being reconnected by a later permission prompt in print and SDK sessions

Fixed hooks that run in PowerShell not blocking when the hook's program exits with code 2, and on Windows PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks with "shell": "powershell" failing open when Git for Windows isn't install…
Changed the /claude-api skill to build Managed Agents subagent teams on multiagent_20261001 with dynamic workflows on by default, instead of coordinator
Fixed /artifacts and the Artifact tool's shared list showing no shared artifacts when you have 200 or more of your own
Improved artifacts with several views: Claude now routes each view on the link's #name and no longer says the address bar stays the same as you switch views
Fixed artifact publishes and updates being refused for some ordinary pages, such as pages with certain minified scripts or artifacts Claude could not read first
Changed subagents and teammates on a different model from the main conversation to use that model's saved effort level or its default, instead of the session's effort level
Added CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's
Fixed sessions failing turn after turn with "Invalid effort level" when an organization's admin caps a model's effort: Claude Code now lowers the effort, retries, and says which level it uses
Fixed the spinner, OpenTelemetry effort values and transcripts naming a newly picked effort level during a task before the model applied it; they now show the level in force

Changed automatic model switches after a flagged message to also cover model names Claude Code doesn't recognize, such as custom deployment names; set CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_FALLBACK=1 to turn them off
[Cloud sessions] Added an effort level to the model picker when you create or edit a routine that runs in the cloud

**examples:** keep the message threads example valid on Sonnet 5.5
**docs:** improve the descriptions of the code execution tool and its encrypted results
**mcp:** remove the stray await from the async tool_runner examples
**client:** link the Bedrock and Vertex raw response docstrings to the SDK documentation
**tools:** leave the tool runner's history to the caller after append_messages(), and keep the current reply out of the set_messages_params() callback
**tools:** keep running the tool runner's function tools when set_messages_params() gives tools as definitions, and stop running one it takes out of tools
**api:** add tool_use_limit_reached_error and compaction_limit_reached_error session error types
**examples:** keep the message threads example valid on Sonnet 5.5
**docs:** improve the descriptions of the code execution tool and its encrypted results
**tools:** copy the messages a tool runner is created with again
**tools:** restore what the tool runner does after setMessagesParams() or pushMessages() in the loop body
